title: Organization settings
intro: Manage the display name and defaults for your organization
name: Organization display name
timeZoneHint: Use a time zone such as Asia/Bangkok, UTC or America/New_York
initializeDefaults: Set default language and time zone
unsetHint: This organization has no defaults. Updating only the name preserves that state.
loadLatest: Load latest values and start again
narrow: This screen shows a read view. Use a wider screen to edit with permission.
draftKept: Your draft stays on this page. A wider screen will recheck current values and access before editing.
discard: You have a draft or an unverified save. Leave or discard this draft?
effectiveHint: Default language and time zone apply on the next page or session load.
personalHint: Personal language and time zone preferences take precedence. Open work continues as before.

validation.name: Enter 2–120 UTF-16 units without control characters
validation.timeZone: Enter a valid time zone such as Asia/Bangkok or UTC

source.CORE_ADMIN: Defaults initialized by an organization administrator

status.VERIFYING: Checking the save and reading values back
status.UNKNOWN: The save result is not confirmed. Check it before editing again.
status.PENDING: The previous result is still being checked. Check again shortly.
status.CONFLICT: Values have changed. Review the latest values before saving again.
status.REVISION_CONFLICT: Values have changed. Your draft stays here. Load the latest values to review and start again.
status.NOT_APPLIED: This command did not change values. Review current values before saving again.
status.REAUTH: Your session expired. Sign in again. Your draft stays on this page.
status.FORBIDDEN: Your current access does not allow organization settings
status.SAVED_LATER: Saved; values were changed again afterward
status.REQUEST_FAILED: Could not load values. Try again.
status.STORAGE: This browser cannot store a save reference. Enable browser storage before saving.
status.RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND: Team not found within your access
status.CONFIG_BUSY: Related configuration is busy. Check the result again
status.RESOURCE_ID_CONFLICT: This team ID already exists. Reload current data
status.COMMAND_PAYLOAD_MISMATCH: The command differs. Check its original result before continuing
